summary: The Macros panel marks any macro the shared library has a newer version of, and the mark loads that version in one click.
details: The amber Update mark appears on the macro's row once the panel has read the shared library, and its tooltip names both versions.
Clicking or pressing the mark copies the library version over the local copy and refreshes the list, without opening the Macro Library window.
An unreachable library leaves the rows unmarked and never delays or blocks the macro list.
